Veeam.title: Outage, Attack, or AI Agent Drift: Lessons from the Microsoft 365 Outage
Veeam.summary: On Thursday, Nov. 12, Microsoft 365 went dark for much of the world. Problems started with Exchange Online around 11:20 a.m. ET, then spread to Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, and even Defender XDR. Outage reports came in from 74 countries and territories, and, by Microsoft's own incident record, the disruption ran just shy of 24 hours. The post Outage, Attack, or AI Agent Drift: Lessons from the Microsoft 365 Outage appeared first on Veeam Software Official Blog .

Cisco.title: Vulnerabilities in nginx Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
Cisco.summary: On November 18, 2026, nginx announced the availability of a fix for multiple critical vulnerabilities in nginx that could lead to remote code execution. These vulnerabilities affect nginx releases 1.9.5 through 1.31.8 and is fixed in releases 1.31.9 (mainline) and 1.30.7 (stable).  These vulnerabilities were identified by the following CVEs: CVE-2026-113425: NGINX ngx_mail_proxy_module vulnerability CVE-2026-121810: NGINX ngx_http_v3_module vulnerability CVE-2026-123007: NGINX ngx_http_v2_module vulnerability CVE-2026-123633: NGINX ngx_http_v2_module vulnerability CVE-2026-123634: NGINX resolver vulnerability For more information, see the nginx Security Advisories . AWS.title: [Preview Announcement] Re-introducing Forward Proxy as AWS Network Firewall Functionality
AWS.summary: You can now use your Network Firewall with all its existing filtering capabilities and features as an explicit forward proxy. On Nov 25, 2025, AWS introduced Network Firewall proxy in public preview to help customers exert centralized security controls against data exfiltration and malware injection. At the time, the Network Firewall proxy was introduced as a standalone product, separate from Network Firewall transparent firewall and used its own separate proxy security policy.
